facts.value: To impart communicative and intercultural language skills in English and refresh and complete existing basic knowledge in the English language.
Three levels are offered: A2/B1, B1, B2.1.
Completion of level A2/B1 of the GER or 26 – 40 points in the placement test.

In the Business English Foundation course, vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world are learned. A variety of exercises are intended to promote linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and form the basis for discussions and written exercises on various economic topics.
The reading and writing component of the course will be assessed in the last week of the semester with a 90-minute written exam. A graded certificate will be issued for passing the exam.
The maximum number of participants in all courses is limited to 20.
90 Euro for WE1A Foundation (13 double hours, including final exam).
Completion of level B1 of the GER or 41 – 60 points in the placement test.

In the Business English Keystone course, vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world are learned. A variety of exercises are intended to promote linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and form the basis for discussions and written exercises on various economic topics.
90 Euro for WE2A, WE2B, WE2C, and WE2D Keystone (13 double hours, including final exam).
Completion of level B2.1 of the GER or 61 – 80 points in the placement test.

In the Business English Higher course, vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world are learned. A variety of exercises are intended to promote linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and form the basis for discussions and written exercises on various economic topics.
90 Euro for WE3A, WE3B, WE3C, and WE3D Higher (13 double hours, including final exam).
